# HitFit — Hit the Target to Be Fit

> Turn screen time into an engaging calorie-burning workout. HitFit is an installable, camera-controlled web fitness game that detects body jumps and sit-to-stand (squat) repetitions in real time.

## Overview
- **Domain**: https://hitfit.zainaxes.com
- **Tagline**: Hit the target to be fit.
- **Creator**: Zain Ul Abidin (Solo Freelancer)
- **Brand**: zainaxes (https://zainaxes.com)
- **Developer Products**:
  - axeskit: https://axeskit.zainaxes.com
  - axeslab: https://axeslab.zainaxes.com
  - axescontrol: https://axescontrol.zainaxes.com
- **Primary Exercises**: Physical jumps and sit-to-stand (squats).
- **Core Technology**: 100% on-device optical and computer vision motion tracking.
- **Privacy Model**: Zero camera recording, zero cloud video streaming. All motion inferences are calculated strictly client-side on the user's browser.
- **Calorie Estimation Engine**: Standardized Compendium of Physical Activities MET formulation (kcal = MET * 3.5 * weight_kg / 200 * duration_minutes), with customizable user weight or generic 70 kg reference.
- **PWA Capabilities**: Installable Progressive Web App with offline service worker precaching, standalone display, and scheduled Web Push reminders.

## Primary Pages & Resources
- **App URL**: [HitFit Web App](https://hitfit.zainaxes.com/)

## Movement Detection Details
- **Jump Detection**: Measures upward shoulder vertical velocity spike. One physical jump triggers an airborne leap for the runner character and counts as one exercise repetition.
- **Sit-to-Stand Detection**: Tracks vertical drop against an auto-calibrated standing baseline. When the user squats down, the on-screen runner ducks/crouches. When the user returns to standing, one squat repetition is recorded.
- **Controls**: 100% camera-controlled body movements. No keyboard simulation or on-screen cheat buttons. Jump over hurdles; squat down beneath flying birds.
